production.goal_summary: Locally recreate a 120-second cinematic highway-driving film with a dark-blue performance coupe, believable traffic, acceleration/release structure, dusk-to-night progression, and candidate-bound QA.

user_quality_signal.label: respectful
user_quality_signal.meaning: Overall mostly good; remaining improvements are refinements/details rather than a foundational failure.

effective_actions.observed_action: Checked Blender/FFmpeg and explicitly tested whether audio/continuous audiovisual perception was available before making review claims.
effective_actions.evidence: Work-session progress screenshots and final review state.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Declare rendering, measurement and perception modalities before production/review; unavailable listening or continuous A/V remains UNVERIFIED rather than becoming a metric-derived PASS.

effective_actions.observed_action: Inspected the existing renderer and found inconsistent vehicle scaling, a side camera switching sides mid-shot, and missing traffic collision checks before reusing it.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Audit inherited production source before cloning it into a remake; preserve the reference and build corrected work separately.

effective_actions.observed_action: Selected a CC0 vehicle kit with separate wheel meshes and verified licensing before adapting it.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Free-resource selection must include provenance, structural suitability and adaptation needs, not visual resemblance alone.

effective_actions.observed_action: Used previews to catch open sky below the road, tire palette errors, bonnet-camera obstruction, side-camera sightline problems, vehicle-fit issues and wheel-motion presentation.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Representative risk previews should precede expensive rendering and intentionally cover camera, geometry, contact, material and motion extremes.

effective_actions.observed_action: Drove hero displacement, wheel rotation, acceleration peaks, engine/wind behavior and traffic pass-by timing from shared motion/trajectory state.
effective_actions.evidence: Production source plus work-session progress screenshots.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Picture and sound events tied to motion should share an authoritative model/event clock rather than independently guessed timings.

effective_actions.observed_action: Detected camera paths intersecting traffic, moved them into lane gaps and verified no vehicle/camera intersections.
effective_actions.evidence: Work-session progress screenshots and cinematic QA.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Run collision, trajectory and camera-clearance checks before full rendering, then visually verify the corrected geometry.

effective_actions.observed_action: Preserved completed shots, reconciled render jobs and resumed only unfinished/repaired work instead of starting over.
effective_actions.evidence: Work-session progress screenshots and production source.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Independent shots/stages should be restart-safe and narrowly invalidated.

effective_actions.observed_action: Bound technical, creative and screening evidence to the exact encoded candidate; inspected authored/text points and all 19 cuts while keeping unavailable perceptual modalities explicit.
effective_actions.evidence: review/ artifacts and final master SHA.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Review the encoded candidate, not source intent; candidate hash and modality-specific evidence control the claim.

effective_actions.observed_action: The follow-on session diagnosed the remaining late-detail failure as a finishing/encode problem and repaired that stage without rebuilding the 3D shots.
effective_actions.evidence: Final cinematic QA and finishing source.
effective_actions.reusable_relationship: Diagnose the failing stage before changing upstream work; source/animation/lighting/mix/assembly/encode failures require different repairs.

late_findings.finding: A review timestamp extended beyond the 120-second master and stopped assembly.
late_findings.avoidable_rework: Assembly failed after all 20 shots were already rendered.
late_findings.new_earlier_gate: Compile and clamp all authored/review timestamps, transitions and text intervals against the legal master duration before rendering.

late_findings.finding: Night streetlight pools created visible bands across distant terrain and tire contact needed refinement.
late_findings.avoidable_rework: A repaired night-lighting pass required shot rerendering.
late_findings.new_earlier_gate: Representative risk previews must include the darkest/night state, distant terrain and contact-shadow views before full rendering.

late_findings.finding: Foreground-car overlap/camera clearance required late inspection.
late_findings.avoidable_rework: Potential camera/subject competition survived until late QA.
late_findings.new_earlier_gate: Include high-density/foreground occlusion risk views in the representative preview pack and numerical clearance checks.

late_findings.finding: Late-night detail passed at source/preview level but final H.264 finishing reduced detail below the unchanged 0.020 gate.
late_findings.avoidable_rework: The final candidate required an additional finishing/encode repair cycle.
late_findings.new_earlier_gate: Encode a short low-light/fine-detail proof using the intended final filter/codec settings and run the same relevant metric before full master encoding.

late_findings.finding: Some status/review actions were repeated with near-duplicate progress entries.
late_findings.avoidable_rework: Extra agent/tool turns without new evidence.
late_findings.new_earlier_gate: Use multi-job polling, distinguish intentional verification from duplicate inspection, and prefer causal finding→repair→recheck updates.

do_not_generalize: specific speed peaks or travel distance
specific camera placements or traffic spacing
H.264 CRF 15 plus grain tuning as a universal encode preset
workflow_changes: Added representative risk-preview and final encode-proof guidance.
Added fresh-agent independent reproducibility as the validation standard for workflow learning.
Added respectful-result learning trigger to AGENTS.md and docs/PRODUCTION_WORKFLOW.md.

fresh_agent_replay.task: Use the revised shared workflow on a future serious local video without relying on this chat or undocumented VELOCITY reasoning.
